en.name: Black pepper, cracked
en.summary: Cracked black pepper keeps 2–3 years from purchase in a cool, dark cupboard — slightly longer than the finely ground kind, because a coarse crack exposes less surface to the air. It does not spoil; it fades.
en.pantry: 2–3 years from purchase in an airtight jar, cool, dark and away from the hob. There is nothing in dried pepper for microbes to live on, so the figure is measuring pungency rather than safety. Pepper's heat comes from piperine and its aroma from volatile oils, and the oils go first: a very old jar still bites but smells of almost nothing. Cracked pepper sits between whole peppercorns, which hold their aroma for years, and fine ground pepper, which fades fastest — the difference is simply how much cut surface is meeting the air.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published for cracked black pepper, and it does not belong in the fridge. It is a dry powder in a humid box: condensation cakes it, and it will pick up smells from everything around it. A sealed jar in a cool cupboard reaches the published figure without any of that.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published either. Whole peppercorns are sometimes frozen for very long storage, but for cracked pepper the condensation on every trip out of the freezer costs more than the cold saves. If you want pepper that tastes of pepper in three years' time, buy peppercorns and a grinder rather than freezing anything.
en.thawing: Not applicable — cracked pepper is a dry cupboard spice and should not be frozen.
spoilage: No smell at all when you warm a pinch in your palm.
A dusty, flat aroma instead of a warm, woody, citrus-edged one.
Caking into hard lumps, which means moisture got in.
Mould or a musty smell in a jar that got damp.
tips: Buy peppercorns and crack them yourself if you want the longest life.
Never shake a jar directly over a steaming pan; the steam gets in.
Keep the jar out of the light and away from the cooker.
Smell before you season — a faded jar just adds grit.

faq.q: How long does cracked black pepper keep?
faq.a: 2–3 years from purchase in an airtight jar in a cool, dark cupboard.
No. It fades. Old pepper loses its aroma and eventually much of its bite, but it is not unsafe unless the jar got damp and grew mould.

faq.q: Why does cracked pepper keep longer than ground?
faq.a: Less cut surface is exposed to the air, so the volatile oils escape more slowly. Whole peppercorns keep longest of all.

zh.name: 粗粒黑胡椒
zh.summary: 粗粒黑胡椒自購買日起，放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃可放 2～3 年——比細磨的稍久一些，因為粗碎暴露在空氣中的表面比較少。它不會腐敗，它是淡掉。
zh.pantry: 氣密罐、陰涼、避光、遠離爐台，自購買日起 2～3 年。乾燥胡椒裡沒有東西可以讓微生物維生，所以這個數字量的是辛香而不是安全。胡椒的辣來自胡椒鹼，香氣來自揮發性精油，而先走的是精油：一罐放很久的胡椒還是會辣，但幾乎聞不到香氣。粗粒黑胡椒的位置介於整粒胡椒（香氣能撐好幾年）與細胡椒粉（退得最快）之間，差別只在於有多少切面正在接觸空氣。
zh.fridge: 粗粒黑胡椒沒有公布的冷藏期限，它也不屬於冰箱。那是把乾粉放進一個潮濕的箱子：結露會讓它結塊，它也會把周圍的味道全吸過來。密封罐放陰涼櫥櫃，不必冒這些險就能走到公布的數字。
zh.freezer: 冷凍同樣沒有期限數據。整粒胡椒有時會為了超長期保存而冷凍，但對粗粒胡椒來說，每次進出冷凍庫的結露，損失比低溫省下來的還多。想要三年後的胡椒還有胡椒味，答案是買整粒和一支研磨罐，而不是拿去冷凍。
zh.thawing: 不適用——粗粒黑胡椒是乾燥的櫥櫃香料，不應冷凍。
spoilage: 在手心搓熱一小撮，完全聞不到味道。
香氣變成灰塵般的平板味，而不是溫暖木質帶柑橘尾韻。
結成硬塊，代表水氣跑進去了。
受潮的罐子長霉或有霉味。
tips: 想要最長的壽命，就買整粒自己壓碎。
絕對不要直接在冒蒸氣的鍋子上方抖罐子，蒸氣會進去。
調味前先聞一下——已經退掉的胡椒只是加了顆粒感。

faq.q: 粗粒黑胡椒可以放多久？
faq.a: 氣密罐放陰涼避光的櫥櫃，自購買日起 2～3 年。
不會，它是淡掉。放久的胡椒會失去香氣、最後連辣度也變弱，但除非罐子受潮長霉，否則並不危險。

faq.q: 為什麼粗粒比胡椒粉耐放？
faq.a: 暴露在空氣中的切面比較少，揮發性精油跑得比較慢。整粒胡椒則是最耐放的。
